title: TMDB Pipeline
description: Full observability — export → enrich → normalize → embed → ingest

panels.title: Low Popularity Filtered
panels.description: Records filtered out before enrichment because their popularity score fell below the configured `min_popularity` threshold. High rates may indicate the threshold is too aggressive.

panels.title: Passthrough Rate
panels.description: Records that bypassed the TMDB API fetch because their kind is marked as passthrough (e.g. keywords). These are enriched directly from the source payload without an additional HTTP request.

panels.title: TMDB API 2xx vs 4xx Rate
panels.description: API response rates by status class. 4xx responses are almost exclusively 404s from resources that have been removed from TMDB — these are silently dropped per the `drop_on: [404]` config and do not trigger retries.
